name: halo-card
title: Halo Card
description: A rounded, frosted dark card with a hairline border and soft multicolour light bleeding from under its bottom edge. It stacks a heading, a short paragraph, an avatar list and two pill buttons, and lights its rim on hover.
use: A dark app needs a standout container for a short list or a settings block.
avoid: The glow is heavy and decorative, so light themes and dense dashboard grids will look busy.
a11y: Focus inside the card triggers the same rim effect as hover, buttons show focus rings, and reduced-motion stops the looping glows. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle in near-black with a translucent, slightly lighter surface and a one-pixel border. A blurred band of pink, magenta and cyan light glows behind the lower half, brightest beneath the footer buttons, and the whole panel sits on a black page.
behaves: The coloured glows drift slowly side to side all the time. Hovering the card or focusing something inside brightens the border and sweeps a moving streak of light around the rim; the primary button carries its own matching glow.
customise: Frosted surface, hover rim and padding are props; the header, title, description, list, footer and buttons are slots you compose from exported subcomponents.
weight: moderate: Three blurred gradient blobs animate forever through motion, plus a frame-loop rim trail.
demo: "Invite your team" card listing Priya Raman, Marcus Webb and Lena Fischer with roles and Cancel / Send invites buttons.
issues: The frames barely move, so the signature hover rim and moving light are never shown.
polishWhy: Crisp spacing and a convincing glassy glow; the recording does not demonstrate its animated rim.
